title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: The email complaint
hook: A long, upset email from a parent arrives at night.
intro: You want to reply right away.
statement: The first reply sets the tone for the whole conversation.
q1: Do you reply briefly and offer a call —
q2: or answer each point in writing?
q3: How will you feel about your reply tomorrow?
t1: Both can work. But hard talks go better
t2: when they happen by voice, not by email.
cta: Coaches — how do you answer complaints?
ctaLines: Wait a day. Offer a call. Keep it short.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A long, upset email from a parent arrives at night.
You read it twice. You want to reply right away.
The first reply sets the tone for the whole conversation.
Offer a call or answer in writing. Both can work.
How do you answer complaints? Share your habit in the comments.
